eyebrow: The three pieces of expected credit loss
code:
Expected Credit Loss =
  PD x LGD x EAD

PD  = Probability of Default
LGD = Loss Given Default
EAD = Exposure at Default
caption: Each piece is driven by something different: creditworthiness, collateral/seniority, and amount owed.
